data.body:
Final rebar-debug report.

Problem — MCP unlink_tickets could not select a relation when one ticket pair held multiple active relations.

Proven root cause — the handwritten adapter in src/rebar/_mcp_writes.py omitted the already-supported optional selector from both its registered FastMCP signature and its rebar.unlink delegate.

Proof — the real server schema exposed only id1/id2; a runtime spy showed a real MCP call forwarded exactly two args and removed newer relates_to; the library control removed explicit blocks. A signature-only experiment made FastMCP accept relation but the unchanged delegate still removed relates_to, independently proving value loss.

Test — tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_unlink_relation.py was collected and legitimately RED before repair because the live schema lacked relation. Held out from the fixer, it became GREEN (2 passed). Restoring the full original signature/delegate omission returned the explicit case to RED at the schema assertion; restoring only the delegate omission returned it to RED at the persisted relation set. Restoring the repair returned 2 GREEN. A formatting-only structural refactor left the oracle GREEN, proving it asserts behavior rather than implementation shape.

Fix — unlink_tickets now declares relation: str | None = None, forwards it unchanged, and documents explicit versus omitted behavior. docs/mcp-reference.md was regenerated from the registered tool contract.

Scope and safety — callers already converge on the proven public library/core contract; no behavioral dependency on the unreachable selector exists. No dependency was added, no existing test weakened, and omitted relation still removes the most-recent edge. Focused live-MCP/library/CLI/reference matrix: 70 passed; MCP reference drift, make lint, make typecheck, and git diff --check pass.

Parity census — rule: unlink must accept an optional relation selector and remove exactly that edge when supplied. CLI: src/rebar/_commands/unlink.py::unlink_cli/unlink_core accepts it. MCP/API: fixed at src/rebar/_mcp_writes.py::unlink_tickets. Public library: src/rebar/_lib_mutations.py::unlink accepts/forwards it. Automated callers: reconciler apply_inbound_records.py already supplies relation explicitly through the public library. Dual-direction mirror: link already requires relation; relates_to reciprocal removal is performed by unlink_core and preserved by the held-out oracle.

Siblings — no second code adapter omission exists for unlink. The maintained ticket-model and packaged CLI overview still state the pre-change no-relation contract; filed and linked asbestos-lithe-kouprey rather than expanding this code repair.

Residual risk and prevention — ticketed documentation drift as asbestos-lithe-kouprey. No other observed fragility remains undispositioned.

Replication — the original real-MCP double-edge scenario now removes explicit blocks while preserving relates_to and its reciprocal; omitting the selector removes newer relates_to and leaves blocks.
